notes.title: Major Update on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello, gamers!

We have released a significant update for our demo version, focusing on enhancing the core gameplay experience. With this update, we have completed the game map, added vehicles, and introduced a character selection menu. Additionally, we have worked on improving the game's atmosphere by adding a few new music tracks and soundtracks.

[b]Key Updates[/b]
Completed Game Map: The entire game area is now fully open for exploration and ready for action-packed moments.
Vehicles Added to the Game: You can now equip and utilize vehicles strategically to defend your town more effectively.
Character Selection Menu: Players can now choose their character before starting the game for a more personalized experience.
New Music and Soundtracks: Several new tracks have been added to enhance the overall atmosphere of the game.
Known Issues and Temporary Solutions
With this update, we have also identified some technical issues that we are actively working to resolve. Here are some of the known bugs:

Bullets moving away from the character when picked up: Occasionally, when a player picks up ammunition, it may appear at a different location instead of near the character. We are currently working on fixing this issue.

Starter equipment not being available at the beginning of the game: Some initial equipment may not appear when the game starts. If you encounter this issue, try reloading the scene as a temporary workaround.

Dead zombies playing unintended animations: After dying, some zombies may start playing animations that shouldn’t be triggered. This can occasionally break the immersion, and we are working on a fix.
Mounted vehicle weapons sometimes lacking recoil: The recoil effect on vehicle-mounted weapons does not always function correctly, which can impact the overall shooting experience.

Issues with weapon focus adjustments on vehicles: The targeting mechanics of vehicle-mounted weapons sometimes do not work as intended, leading to imprecise aiming.

With this update, we've taken another step forward, but there are still areas that need improvement. We will continue refining the game based on your feedback.

Our demo version will be available on Steam very soon. Thank you in advance for your support and comments—please share your thoughts with us!
